decisions.reason: Using Fun Fact images to fill article-ending white space does not change which cover-mentioned articles must be included or where they are placed.
The client reiterates a preference for Garamond, which is already the current body-font requirement; the new filler-image decision does not change typography state.
Fun Fact filler images do not alter category-label display, placement, allowed categories, or article-category mappings.
Attaching backup advertisements and proposing Fun Fact images do not change the requirement that advertisements render clearly without blurriness.
The filler-image option does not modify the existing polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
Introducing possible Fun Fact images does not change the existing rule to enhance publication images with AI when necessary.
The proposed filler images do not change the Civic Lantern website as the source of article content.
The white-space filler decision does not alter author-name, author-photo identity, source, or placement requirements.
Fun Fact images for affected article endings do not change inclusion or placement of the supplied tribute page.
The proposed filler assets do not modify the required circular shape or small size of author photographs.
The assembly requirement already includes images among its content inputs; selecting Fun Fact images for white-space correction does not change its current assembly behavior or Flat Plan reference.
The filler-image decision concerns article-ending content balance and does not change the requirement to create the magazine layout template.
